hooks.command: sh -c '[ -n "$HUNKBOARD_REMOTE" ] || exit 0; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0; branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null | tr / -); out="$HOME/.cache/hunkboard/$(basename "$PWD")/$branch"; [ -f "$out/diff.json" ] || exit 0; "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/hunkboard-publish" --out "$out" >/dev/null && "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/hunkboard-push" --from "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true'
